summary.name: [re:Work] Postmortem Exercise
summary.one_liner: A Google Docs template from re:Work (Google's re:Work guidance site) offering an exercise for running a team postmortem after a project is completed.
use_cases: Running a team retrospective after a project finishes
Reviewing what went wrong and what went right on a project
Documenting lessons learned for future projects
Facilitating a postmortem discussion with a team
Pairing with a premortem to review how risks changed
summary.what_it_does: The page is a Google Docs document titled "[re:Work] Postmortem Exercise". Its description says a postmortem is a chance for a team to step back after a project is completed and learn from past mistakes and wins. It notes that problems can change or new ones can emerge during a project, so premortems do not catch everything. The visible text is mostly Google Docs interface menus and language lists, so the exercise steps themselves are not visible in the extracted text.
notable: Based on the re:Work guidance material, a Google-published resource
Listed in awesome-sre under Post-Mortem as a discussion template
Shared as a Google Doc viewable by anyone with the link
caveats: Extracted page text shows only Google Docs UI, so the exercise questions are not visible
Pricing is inferred from free link access; no price is stated on the page
